description: Get the execution plan (EXPLAIN) for a SQL query without running it. postgres/mysql return a JSON plan; redshift returns a text plan (Redshift supports neither FORMAT JSON nor EXPLAIN ANALYZE, and its cost numbers are relative — do not compare them to postgres costs).

database.description: Database to explain against; required when the connection declares multiple databases

query.description: SQL text to explain (the query itself is not executed)

name: query_plan
